answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake in a cryptographic burn vault before admission. Each replica registered by a single identity triggers a cost spiral where burned collateral scales superlinearly as $C(n) = k \cdot n^2$. Carving unforgeable proofs into immutable storage like carved marble prevents identity recycling, while resource dissipation leaves Sybils frozen in an economic tundra where exponential scaling guarantees attack costs exceed any potential payoff.
